content:
maya: Quick-ish design review — three matrix options in this frame: compact grid, grouped-by-role, and nested-permission view. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/roles-matrix?node-id=23 chris: Got it. Quick Q — which option keeps invite CTA above the fold on 1280w? we need that for PLG. olivia: compact grid keeps CTA visible but sacrifices scanability when there are 20+ roles. grouped-by-role scales better for large orgs. sam: For implementation: grouped-by-role needs nested expanders, which means keyboard focus trap considerations. I'll need aria ids. aaron: a11y: prefer expand/collapse buttons with aria-expanded and aria-controls. Also ensure single-table keyboard nav works. Example: ```
    ...
``` maya: Nice. Also debating invite CTA copy: "Send invite" vs "Invite member" vs "Add to org". Chris — preference? chris: "Invite member" is clearer for admins; "Add to org" feels admin-y and permanent. Also think we need inline microcopy: what happens when you invite — does role assignment send auto email? olivia: Proposal for tooltip copy under role selector: "Assigns this role's permissions to the invited user. Permissions can be adjusted later from Members > [user]." short and scannable. sam: Can we make the role pill include a hover affordance that shows the permissions count? e.g., "Role • 12 perms". Low cost. :thumbsup: maya: SSO toggle copy — current options: "Require SSO for org" / "Enforce SSO login" / "SSO required for all users". Which is accessible and least ambiguous? aaron: Avoid "require" without explaining exceptions. Suggest: "Require SSO for all sign-ins (enforced)" and add an info tooltip linking to audit docs. chris: Agree. Also add short line below toggle: "Legacy tokens and service accounts are unaffected" if that's true. olivia: For audit log nav: people reported it's hard to jump to a user-specific trail. Suggest a deep-link pattern: /orgs/:orgId/audit?actor=:userId and an inline search box that supports @mentions. sam: Backend note — we already have actor filter param, just need UI to surface it. I'll add a small query param helper in the console nav. maya: One more thing — keyboard order when opening invite modal from roles page: focus should land on email input, not role selector. small but important. aaron: And add aria-live region for invite success/failure messages. deploy-bot: Reminder — design branch deploy scheduled at 2025-11-05T17:30Z :rocket: chris: OK next steps: Olivia to push final copy + updated Figma screens by Friday. Sam to estimate nested expander work. Aaron to provide final a11y checklist. maya: Thanks — quick reactions please :eyes: if you looked, :thumbsup: if you're ok with the plan.
